Hi Leah / Devon,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — appreciate the product context and the walkthrough of the use case (patient intake summarization + clinical reranking). Quick recap from our side and a list of follow-ups so we can scope Dedicated capacity and the integration effort.

High-level asks (we can cover these in a short ops call):
- SDK & auth: will you be using service accounts or an API gateway? Do you require mTLS or KMS integration for keys?
- Routing & fallbacks: expected % of traffic that needs low-latency (UI) vs background rerank jobs. Any regional routing constraints?
- Tooling & structured outputs: you mentioned tool-calling for lab lookups — do you need function schemas + strict JSON output enforcement?
- Embeddings/reranker flow: are embeddings computed client-side or in a batch pipeline? Target QPS for reranker + offline embedding refresh cadence?
- Dedicated sizing: target steady-state QPS, peak burst multiplier, and desired concurrency per model. Any SLA or RTO requirements?

I've attached a short ops checklist and the draft architecture diagram so you can mark what looks right. If helpful, we can do a 45-minute technical sync next week to finalize sizing and auth details; proposed slots below.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm the answers (or share who on your side owns each bullet).
2) Technical sync (45 min) with your infra and dev lead + our infra engineer (Soojin) and Markus for capacity.
3) Draft Dedicated sizing proposal and cost estimate.

Availability (PDT): Mon 8/16 10:00-11:30, Tue 8/17 13:00-15:00, Wed 8/18 09:00-11:00.

Jonas / team —

Thanks for the concise recap and the attachments — I skimmed the diagram and it lines up with our internal thinking. Quick answers to your bullets to help prep the tech sync:

- Auth: we'll want service-account style credentials that we manage in our KMS. No mTLS for now; we do require key rotation support and an audit log showing token exchange.
- Routing: ~70% of traffic is UI-driven (95th-pct latency target 250ms) and ~30% are nightly rerank batches (throughput > 10k/doc/day). Regions: all US.
- Structured outputs: yes, we need strict JSON function output for lab_lookup + medication_normalize. We'll provide schemas.
- Embeddings: embedding refreshes will be nightly via our ETL (Airflow). Reranker will call embeddings at inference time for a candidate set. Expected concurrent rerank requests: 40-60 QPS during business hours.
- Sizing: we're focused on predictable latency for UI paths; willing to commit to a baseline if the cost estimates match. Procurement/finance will need a formal SOW and pricing; procurement cc'ed.

Can Soo jin (cc'd) and Markus be on the call to get sizing nailed down? Proposed window Tue 8/17 14:00 PDT works for our infra lead.

Leah / team —

Appreciate the context. Answers and proposed next steps below — will walk through these on Tue 8/17 (14:00 PDT).

1) Auth & audit logs
- Yes, Dedicated supports customer-managed service accounts with key material stored in your KMS. We use a token-issuing service that can accept KMS-wrapped keys; rotation is supported and audit events (token issue/revoke) are streamed to your audit endpoint or S3. Implementation note: we'll need an integration window to exchange key manifests and validate rotation policies.

2) Latency profile & instance selection
- For the UI path (250ms @95p) where you need embeddings + candidate rerank + 1 function call, we recommend:
  * Model split: quantized Llama-2.1-13B (UI) and full 13B/70B variant for offline rerank when quality delta matters.
  * HW: fleet of A10G-equivalent instances for UI routing with continuous batching disabled for critical paths, pinned concurrency per replica of 4-6 inference threads depending on sequence length.
  * Expected single-request median: 80-120ms token time; end-to-end depends on prompt length and reranker complexity. We'll provision a small canary pool to validate.

3) Concurrency & queueing
- Recommendation: separate queues for UI vs batch. UI queue: low-latency SLO, small request-based concurrency per node (4-6). Batch queue: throughput-first, token-based autoscaling with larger concurrency per node.
- For 40-60 QPS rerank steady-state with 2x burst headroom, initial Dedicated pool: 6-8 A10G-equivalent replicas for the reranker model (configurable). We'll provide a sizing spreadsheet during the call to let you tweak assumptions (prompt size, candidate set size).

4) Caching & cost control
- Prefix/KV cache: for UI flows where patients share common system prompts, expect 20-40% token reduction for warm prefixes. We'll estimate costs in the sizing doc but plan for a cache hit rate test during the POC.

5) Structured tool-calling
- Dedicated supports function/tool calling with strict JSON schema enforcement. We'll accept your schemas and configure a validation layer; failures can be routed to a retry/fallback model variant.

Attachments: I attached a draft ops checklist and architecture diagram with recommended pool sizes and a slot for procurement terms.

Proposed call attendees: Leah, Devon, Beacon infra lead, procurement rep, Jonas, Soojin, myself.

I'll draft the SOW + initial pricing after the call based on tuned sizing assumptions. If you want an initial cost estimate before Tue, say so and we'll send a ballpark.

Best,
